items.t: Novavax Eyes New Partnerships as Sanofi Advances COVID-Flu Vaccine Trial
items.sum: Novavax (NASDAQ:NVAX) is looking to expand partnerships around its vaccine technology while advancing a potential C. difficile vaccine and supporting partner Sanofi’s development of a combination COVID-19 and flu shot, executives said at the Jefferies 2026 Global Healthcare Conference in London.
